# Esquemas Clases Argentina

Capítulo para armar los diferentes esquemas de clases con la **base de datos de Argentina**.

> Datos actualizados al {{< meta date >}}.

## Preparación

```{r librerias, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())
options(scipen = 999)

library(pacman)
p_load(
  # generacion docs 
  flextable,         # tablas personalizadas para word
  kableExtra,        # mejorar tablas
  knitr,             # generar reportes reproducibles
  officer,           # crear/modifcar documentos word o ppt
  tinytex,           # instalación mínima de LaTeX para generar PDF
  
  # importacion datos 
  haven,             # impotar/exportar datos spss, stata, sas con etiquetas
  readr,             # lectura rápida de csv
  readxl,            # leer excel 
  
  # manipulacion 
  forcats,           # manipulación de factores
  janitor,           # limpia etiquetas
  labelled,          # trabajar con variables etiquetadas
  purrr,             # programación funcional para listas y data frames
  sjlabelled,        # manejar etiquetas 
  stringr,           # manipular texto
  sjmisc,            # limpieza y descripción de datos
  
  # visualizacion
  ggplot2,           # visualización basado en gramática de gráficos
  ggrepel,           # etiquetas en gráficos sin superposición
  gridExtra,         # combinar gráficos en uno solo
  scales,            # controla cómo se ven los ejes en gráficos
  sjPlot,            # visualizar resultados estadísticos
  
  # analisis
  psych,             # análisis general, psicométrico
  survey,            # diseño survey encuestas complejas
  srvyr,             # diseño survey con tidy
  rlang,             # motor interno de tidyverse, para usar expresiones 
  tidyverse,
  statar             # conectar con el lenguaje stata

  # # conexion web
  # curl,              # conexiones http de bajo nivel: para solucionar el problema de la api del ine
  # httr               # cliente http para API
  )
```

### Cargar datos

```{r datos, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
data <- readRDS("output/data/data-conclat-ar-es-clases.rds")
```

### Setups

```{r , message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source("wright_system.R")
source("wright_layouts_defs.R")
source("wright_get_counts.R")
```

## Classes

### Esquema de clases de Erik Olin Wright

![](img/wright_classes.jpeg)

### wrightclass_v1_original

```{r}
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    wrightclass_v1_original = case_when(
      as.integer(owners) == 3 ~ 1,  # 1. Employers
      as.integer(owners) == 2 ~ 2,  # 2. Small employers
      as.integer(owners) == 1 ~ 3,  # 3. Petty bourgeoisie
      
      as.integer(organization_assets) == 1 & as.integer(skills) == 1 ~ 4,  # 4. Expert managers
      as.integer(organization_assets) == 2 & as.integer(skills) == 1 ~ 5,  # 5. Expert supervisors
      as.integer(organization_assets) == 3 & as.integer(skills) == 1 ~ 6,  # 6. Experts
      
      as.integer(organization_assets) == 1 & as.integer(skills) == 2 ~ 7,  # 7. Skilled managers
      as.integer(organization_assets) == 2 & as.integer(skills) == 2 ~ 8,  # 8. Skilled supervisors
      as.integer(organization_assets) == 3 & as.integer(skills) == 2 ~ 9,  # 9. Skilled workers
      
      as.integer(organization_assets) == 1 & as.integer(skills) == 3 ~ 10, # 10. Nonskilled managers
      as.integer(organization_assets) == 2 & as.integer(skills) == 3 ~ 11, # 11. Nonskilled supervisors
      as.integer(organization_assets) == 3 & as.integer(skills) == 3 ~ 12  # 12. Nonskilled workers
    ),
    wrightclass_v1_original = factor(
      wrightclass_v1_original,
      levels = 1:12,
      labels = c(
        "1. Employers",
        "2. Small employers",
        "3. Petty bourgeoisie",
        "4. Expert managers",
        "5. Expert supervisors",
        "6. Experts",
        "7. Skilled managers",
        "8. Skilled supervisors",
        "9. Skilled workers",
        "10. Nonskilled managers",
        "11. Nonskilled supervisors",
        "12. Nonskilled workers"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  set_variable_labels(wrightclass_v1_original = "Wright Class Typology (v1 original)")

frq(data$wrightclass_v1_original)

# base survey
data_svy <- as_survey_design(data, weights = pondera)

# Tabla de frecuencias ponderadas
wright_freq <- data_svy %>%
  group_by(wrightclass_v1_original) %>%
  summarise(
    freq = survey_mean(vartype = NULL, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_unweighted = unweighted(n())
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    freq_pct = freq * 100
  )

wright_freq %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

- Esquema original con **Employers: employers con 10 o más trabajadores**.

```{r}
#| label: fig-wright-v1
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7
#| echo: false

counts_v1 <- get_counts(data, wrightclass_v1_original)

draw_wright(wright_layout("v1"), counts_v1,
            title = "v1 · Original (Employers)",
            row_labels_left = wright_rowlabels("v1"))
```

### wrightclass_v3_emp_informal

```{r}
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    wrightclass_v3_emp_informal = case_when(
      as.integer(owners) == 3 ~ 1,  # 1. Employers
      as.integer(owners) == 2 ~ 2,  # 2. Small employers

      as.integer(owners) == 1 & formal_educ == 1 ~ 3,   # 3. Petty bourgeoisie

      as.integer(organization_assets) == 1 & as.integer(skills) == 1 ~ 4,  # 4. Expert managers
      as.integer(organization_assets) == 2 & as.integer(skills) == 1 ~ 5,  # 5. Expert supervisors
      as.integer(organization_assets) == 3 & as.integer(skills) == 1 ~ 6,  # 6. Experts

      as.integer(organization_assets) == 1 & as.integer(skills) == 2 ~ 7,  # 7. Skilled managers
      as.integer(organization_assets) == 2 & as.integer(skills) == 2 ~ 8,  # 8. skilled supervisors
      as.integer(organization_assets) == 1 & as.integer(skills) == 3 ~ 9,  # 9. Nonskilled managers
      as.integer(organization_assets) == 2 & as.integer(skills) == 3 ~ 10, # 10. Nonskilled supervisors

      as.integer(organization_assets) == 3 & as.integer(skills) %in% c(2, 3) & contrato == 1 ~ 11, # 11. Formal workers
      as.integer(organization_assets) == 3 & as.integer(skills) %in% c(2, 3) & contrato == 0 ~ 12, # 12. Informal workers
      as.integer(owners) == 1 & formal_educ == 0 ~ 13                                                   # 13. Informal self-employed
    ),
    wrightclass_v3_emp_informal = factor(
      wrightclass_v3_emp_informal,
      levels = 1:13,
      labels = c(
        "1. Employers",
        "2. Small employers",
        "3. Petty bourgeoisie",
        "4. Expert managers",
        "5. Expert supervisors",
        "6. Experts",
        "7. Skilled managers",
        "8. Skilled supervisors",
        "9. Nonskilled managers",
        "10. Nonskilled supervisors",
        "11. Formal workers",
        "12. Informal workers",
        "13. Informal self-employed"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  set_variable_labels(wrightclass_v3_emp_informal = "Wright Class Typology + Informal (v3)")

frq(data$wrightclass_v3_emp_informal)

# base survey
data_svy <- as_survey_design(data, weights = pondera)

# Tabla de frecuencias ponderadas
wright_freq <- data_svy %>%
  group_by(wrightclass_v3_emp_informal) %>%
  summarise(
    freq = survey_mean(vartype = NULL, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_unweighted = unweighted(n())
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    freq_pct = freq * 100
  )

wright_freq %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

- Esquema con **Employers: 10 o más trabajadores**.
- **Trabajadores divididos en formales e informales por tipo de aportes jubilatorios**.
- **Autoempleados divididos en formales e informales por nivel universitario completado**.

```{r}
#| label: fig-wright-v3
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7
#| echo: false

counts_v3 <- get_counts(data, wrightclass_v3_emp_informal)

draw_wright(wright_layout("v3"), counts_v3,
            title = "v3 · Employers + Informals",
            row_labels_left = wright_rowlabels("v3"))
```

### wrightclass_v5_emp_reduced (comp. cl-ar)

```{r}
# Modelo para comprar con datos de Argentina
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    wrightclass_v5_emp_reduced = case_when(
      as.integer(owners) == 3 ~ 1,                                                                 # 1. Employers
      as.integer(owners) == 2 ~ 2,                                                                 # 2. Small employers
      as.integer(owners) == 1 & formal_educ == 1 ~ 3,                                                   # 3. Petty bourgeoisie
      as.integer(organization_assets) == 1 & as.integer(skills) %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 4,               # 4. Managers
      as.integer(organization_assets) == 2 & as.integer(skills) %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 5,               # 5. Supervisors
      as.integer(organization_assets) == 3 & as.integer(skills) == 1 ~ 6,                          # 6. Experts
      as.integer(organization_assets) == 3 & as.integer(skills) %in% c(2, 3) & contrato == 1 ~ 7,  # 7. Formal workers
      as.integer(organization_assets) == 3 & as.integer(skills) %in% c(2, 3) & contrato == 0 ~ 8,  # 8. Informal workers
      as.integer(owners) == 1 & formal_educ == 0 ~ 9                                                    # 9. Informal self-employed
    ),
    wrightclass_v5_emp_reduced = factor(
      wrightclass_v5_emp_reduced,
      levels = 1:9,
      labels = c(
        "1. Employers",
        "2. Small employers",
        "3. Petty bourgeoisie",
        "4. Managers",
        "5. Supervisors",
        "6. Experts",
        "7. Formal workers",
        "8. Informal workers",
        "9. Informal self-employed"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  set_variable_labels(wrightclass_v5_emp_reduced = "Wright Class Typology Reduced (v5)")

frq(data$wrightclass_v5_emp_reduced)

# base survey
data_svy <- as_survey_design(data, weights = pondera)

# Tabla de frecuencias ponderadas
wright_freq <- data_svy %>%
  group_by(wrightclass_v5_emp_reduced) %>%
  summarise(
    freq = survey_mean(vartype = NULL, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_unweighted = unweighted(n())
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    freq_pct = freq * 100
  )

wright_freq %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

- Esquema reducido con Employers: 10 o más trabajadores.
- Trabajadores divididos en formales e informales por tipo de aportes jubilatorios.
- Autoempleados divididos en formales e informales por nivel universitario completado.
- **Se unen todos los Managers**.
- **Se unen todos los Supervisors**.

```{r}

#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7
#| echo: false

            title = "v5 · Employers reduced",
            row_labels_left = wright_rowlabels("v5"))
```

### wrightclass_v8_emp_reduced

**Se pondrá v15 solamente para que tenga el mismo código que en Chile**.

```{r}
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    wrightclass_v15_emp_reduced = case_when(
      as.integer(owners) == 3 ~ 1,                                                                   # 1. Employers
      as.integer(owners) == 2 ~ 2,                                                                   # 2. Small employers
      as.integer(owners) == 1 & formal_educ == 1 ~ 3,                                                     # 3. Petty bourgeoisie

      as.integer(organization_assets) == 1 & as.integer(skills) == 1 ~ 4,                            # 4. Expert managers
      as.integer(organization_assets) == 3 & as.integer(skills) == 1 ~ 5,                            # 5. Experts

      as.integer(organization_assets) %in% c(1, 2) & as.integer(skills) %in% c(2, 3) ~ 6,            # 6. Skilled y Nonskilled Supervisors
      as.integer(organization_assets) == 2 & as.integer(skills) == 1 ~ 6,                            # 6. Skilled y Nonskilled Supervisors

      as.integer(organization_assets) == 3 & as.integer(skills) %in% c(2, 3) & contrato == 1 ~ 7,    # 7. Formal workers
      as.integer(organization_assets) == 3 & as.integer(skills) %in% c(2, 3) & contrato == 0 ~ 8,    # 8. Informal workers
      as.integer(owners) == 1 & formal_educ == 0 ~ 9                                                      # 9. Informal self-employed
    ),
    wrightclass_v15_emp_reduced = factor(
      wrightclass_v15_emp_reduced,
      levels = 1:9,
      labels = c(
        "1. Employers",
        "2. Small employers",
        "3. Petty bourgeoisie",
        "4. Expert managers",
        "5. Experts",
        "6. Skilled & Nonskilled Supervisors",
        "7. Formal workers",
        "8. Informal workers",
        "9. Informal self-employed"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  set_variable_labels(wrightclass_v15_emp_reduced = "Wright Class Typology Reduced (v15)")

frq(data$wrightclass_v15_emp_reduced)

# base survey
data_svy <- as_survey_design(data, weights = pondera)

# Tabla de frecuencias ponderadas
wright_freq <- data_svy %>%
  group_by(wrightclass_v15_emp_reduced) %>%
  summarise(
    freq = survey_mean(vartype = NULL, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_unweighted = unweighted(n())
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    freq_pct = freq * 100
  )

wright_freq %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

- Esquema reducido con Employers: 10 o más trabajadores.
- Trabajadores divididos en formales e informales por tipo de aportes jubilatorios.
- Autoempleados divididos en formales e informales por nivel universitario completado.
- **Se unen todos los Supervisors y Mangers no expertos**.

```{r}
#| label: fig-wright-v15
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7
#| echo: false

counts_v15 <- get_counts(data, wrightclass_v15_emp_reduced)

            title = "v15 · Employers reduced",
            row_labels_left = wright_rowlabels("v15"))
```

### wrightclass_v9_cap_reduced

**Se pondrá v16 solamente para que tenga el mismo código que en Chile**.

```{r}
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    wrightclass_v16_cap_reduced = case_when(
      as.integer(owners2) == 3 ~ 1,                                                                   # 1. Capitalists
      as.integer(owners2) == 2 ~ 2,                                                                   # 2. Small employers
      as.integer(owners2) == 1 & formal_educ == 1 ~ 3,                                                     # 3. Petty bourgeoisie

      as.integer(organization_assets) == 1 & as.integer(skills) == 1 ~ 4,                             # 4. Expert managers
      as.integer(organization_assets) == 3 & as.integer(skills) == 1 ~ 5,                             # 5. Experts

      as.integer(organization_assets) %in% c(1, 2) & as.integer(skills) %in% c(2, 3) ~ 6,             # 6. Skilled y Nonskilled Supervisors
      as.integer(organization_assets) == 2 & as.integer(skills) == 1 ~ 6,                             # 6. Skilled y Nonskilled Supervisors

      as.integer(organization_assets) == 3 & as.integer(skills) %in% c(2, 3) & contrato == 1 ~ 7,     # 7. Formal workers
      as.integer(organization_assets) == 3 & as.integer(skills) %in% c(2, 3) & contrato == 0 ~ 8,     # 8. Informal workers
      as.integer(owners2) == 1 & formal_educ == 0 ~ 9                                                      # 9. Informal self-employed
    ),
    wrightclass_v16_cap_reduced = factor(
      wrightclass_v16_cap_reduced,
      levels = 1:9,
      labels = c(
        "1. Capitalists",
        "2. Small employers",
        "3. Petty bourgeoisie",
        "4. Expert managers",
        "5. Experts",
        "6. Skilled & Nonskilled Supervisors",
        "7. Formal workers",
        "8. Informal workers",
        "9. Informal self-employed"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  set_variable_labels(wrightclass_v16_cap_reduced = "Wright Class Typology Reduced (v16)")

frq(data$wrightclass_v16_cap_reduced)

# base survey
data_svy <- as_survey_design(data, weights = pondera)

# Tabla de frecuencias ponderadas
wright_freq <- data_svy %>%
  group_by(wrightclass_v16_cap_reduced) %>%
  summarise(
    freq = survey_mean(vartype = NULL, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_unweighted = unweighted(n())
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    freq_pct = freq * 100
  )

wright_freq %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

- Esquema reducido con Capitalists: 50 o más trabajadores.
- Trabajadores divididos en formales e informales por tipo de aportes jubilatorios.
- Autoempleados divididos en formales e informales por nivel universitario completado.
- **Se unen todos los Supervisors y Mangers no expertos**.

      as.integer(organization_assets) == 3 & as.integer(skills) %in% c(2, 3) & contrato == 1 ~ 6,      # 6. Formal workers
      as.integer(organization_assets) == 3 & as.integer(skills) %in% c(2, 3) & contrato == 0 ~ 7,      # 7. Informal workers
